name: Trang An
kicker: Sampans rowed through the tower karst
summary: Sampan through the tower karst on sông Sào Khê, the valley's main boat. An adult over 1.3 m pays 300,000 đồng. A child from 1 m to 1.3 m pays 150,000 đồng, and a child under 1 m goes free. Towers rise to 200 m. The core runs 6,172–6,226 ha, the buffer 6,026–6,079 ha, and the whole about 12,252 ha. About 14,000 people live here. Give the boat the morning.
dotReason: The sampan in the towers is the reason for the night
fee: 300,000 đồng for an adult over 1.3 m
getThere: From the valley. About 90 km southeast of Hà Nội.
heroCaption: Limestone towers, the river, and sampans at Tràng An

notice.title: Khê Cốc and the Ngo Đồng boat are other tickets
notice.body: The Ngo Đồng boat belongs to Tam Coc. Đảo Khê Cốc is a separate line: adult 100,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 50,000 đồng, under 1 m free.

body: You sit low in the boat. Forested towers rise on both sides, up to 200 m, and the guide rows. The water is sông Sào Khê. About 14,000 people live in the landscape. The core is given as 6,172 ha and as 6,226 ha. The buffer is given as 6,026 ha and as 6,079 ha. A combined figure of about 12,252 ha is also in use.

The office is Số 6, Đường Tràng An, Phường Hoa Lư. The ticket hotline is 19009251. The support line is 02293.886.068. Đảo Khê Cốc sits on its own fare: adult 100,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 50,000 đồng, under 1 m free. Give the sampan the morning, while the light is still on the towers.

figures.caption: Sampans under a cliff at Tràng An, a different bend from the hero
figures.alt: Two sampans on the river beneath a limestone cliff and a banyan at Tràng An

gettingThere: Sleep in the Hoa Lư valley and the wharf is the first move. From Ga Ninh Bình you need a ride. The landscape is about 90 km southeast of Hà Nội. Bái Đính is about 100 km from Hà Nội, a different end of the same valley.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: By train to Ga Ninh Bình, then a ride. SE7 leaves Hà Nội at 06:00 and arrives at 08:16, two hours and 16 minutes, at kilometre 115.

legs.heading: From the valley
legs.body: Walk or ride to the Tràng An wharf if you slept near it. The office is Số 6, Đường Tràng An, Phường Hoa Lư.

admissionNote: Adult over 1.3 m: 300,000 đồng. Child from 1 m to 1.3 m: 150,000 đồng. Under 1 m free. Đảo Khê Cốc, separate: adult 100,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 50,000 đồng, under 1 m free. Hotline 19009251. Support phone 02293.886.068.
